basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old living in Jacksonville, Florida, and I work as a freelance graphic designer. I've always been a bit introspective, often losing myself in my thoughts and occasionally struggling to assert my preferences, especially in group settings. I have a deep interest in self-improvement and personal growth, which has led me to read extensively on psychology and mindfulness. I enjoy spending my free time exploring new music, diving into RPGs, and connecting with people who have similar life experiences. I'm currently single and open to meeting new people. My typical online hours are late evenings, as my work schedule is quite flexible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a minor in Psychology. Over the years, I've expanded my understanding of human behavior through personal reading and attending workshops. My work as a freelance designer often involves a lot of self-directed learning and adapting to new tools and trends in the design industry.
